body.p:
Benjamin DAVID
Atty Docket No.: JHN-6142-0035
The indication of allowability of claims 1 to 15 is appreciated.
The objection to the drawings is overcome by adding identifying text to the lager boxes in figures 1 to 4. The smaller boxes are too small to insert text.

To address the rejection that claim 1 is indefinite, claim 1 is amended to clarify that the APU receives information contained in data from the electrical power controller, data indicative of aircraft operational parameters or a signal received from a manually activated device.
To address the rejection that claim 10 is indefinite, claim 10 is amended to clarify that the APU controller selects the normal or emergency starter.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, or credit any
overpayment, in the fee(s) filed, or asserted to be filed, or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to Deposit Account No.
